I have farmed this land since I was a boy and I know the soil here is weak, so I will apply two bags of NPK fertilizer — the dealer told me that gives about 20 kg of nitrogen per hectare — and I will also spread cow dung because this plot is mine and I want to keep it strong. I will plant my own millet seed that I saved from last year since it sprouts well and I do not have cash to waste on new seed if the rains fail again. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because millet grows with the rains and I cannot afford a pump. My sons and I will do most of the work ourselves, about 50 days in total this season, but I will hire two young men for five days when the weeds are thick.
